To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the mobile school format can be a powerful tool in addressing the lack of quality education in challenging and poverty contexts, and that it is an innovative approach to the design of educational environments and learning ecosystems that can be adapted to a wide variety of challenging locations and extreme poverty contexts.

mobile schools can be a viable alternative for providing education services to unprivileged children in extreme poverty contexts, if designed and implemented as an integral part of a comprehensive educational ecosystem, which includes the school as a physical learning space, a mobile school, a digital school, a learning community, and a learning environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of learning environments in extreme contexts and poverty afflicted locations.

the following question: How can the design of learning environments and the use of digital technologies contribute to the improvement of access, quality and equity of education in extreme poverty contexts?

the design of learning environments that are able to scale up and to reach out, that are able to adapt to the local context and culture, that can be implemented in a cost-effective manner and that are able to deliver quality education.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the InnoSchool Learning Laboratory is a mobile school format that can be deployed to serve children in extreme locations and poverty afflicted contexts, where conventional schooling is not feasible, or not sustainable, and where children are deprived of educational opportunities.

the mobile school concept, with its innovative learning ecosystem, can be a powerful instrument to improve educational access and quality in challenging contexts, but it requires strong and committed partners to implement it.
the InnoSchool Learning lab project, in the context of the Venice Biennale, represents a significant step forward in the development of innovative school formats for challenging contexts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we aim at creating a new kind of learning environment, an ‘InnoSchool Learning Lab’ format, which is not only mobile, flexible, re-locatable, and adaptable, but which also is a learning environment in its own right.
InnoSchool Learning lab is a new kind of school for new kinds of students.
the project InnoSchool aims to create new learning ecosystems, which are mobile, flexible, scalable and adaptable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need to re-think and re-design the learning ecosystem in order to make education more relevant and accessible in the digital era, in order to empower the unprivileged.
the future of education is not in the classroom but in the learning ecosystem.
we need to design and deliver education and schooling services in a more agile, responsive and flexible manner in order to meet the needs of the most vulnerable children and youth in a timely manner.
